releasePolicy.baseline: Every QR-indexed core row is materialized automatically into the knowledge bundle.
releasePolicy.enrichment: Verified knowledge records overlay the baseline by stable coreCode; unverified legacy rows remain queryable with legacy_core evidence status.
releasePolicy.knowledgeOnlyCandidates: Authoritatively sourced knowledge nodes may exist without a QR coreCode; this does not grant QR append approval.
releasePolicy.verifiedLegacyCandidates: Source-verified legacy candidate rows may receive knowledge enrichment without changing their frozen v6 QR row, code, entityType or status.
releasePolicy.ambiguity: Researched same-name ambiguity, source-geography conflicts and likely type/taxonomy errors are published as explicit resolution issues; consumers must not treat those rows as safe name-only automatic matches.
releasePolicy.consumerResolution: Resolution issues may require context or explicit user confirmation for new recognition while historical decoded QR coreCodes remain permanently decodable.
releasePolicy.identity: Confirmed duplicate entity and geography core codes remain permanently decodable and may resolve to canonical identity IDs for search/display deduplication.
releasePolicy.localization: AI-translated/transliterated names remain explicitly typed and pending market verification; they never replace official/canonical names automatically.
releasePolicy.compatibility: Knowledge release must never change QR row indexes.
releasePolicy.publication: PR builds and verifies a candidate; main publishes a deterministic hashed release.
